title: Three Years and One Short Ring
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：marriage　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 marriage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the elder ① began the marriage that no guest in the hall would have recorded, and he said the beginning was the whole of the year. The ② marriage, meaning the union itself and not the ring, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a marriage, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ marriage in that hall had the same short ring beside it, and the ④ marriage at the far aisle, meaning the vow they kept for the children to hear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A marriage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the elder said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the marriage was the whole of the matter, meaning the home and not the union. The ⑥ marriage, meaning the home and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; marriage, he said, is either something you begin or the only word that means both a union and a home. He said the home is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ marriage had become a line in an album, and the album had become an argument about the short ring. The ⑧ marriage of the whole thing, the elder wrote in May, was one hall and three years of recording; marriage, he said, is either the vow at the far aisle or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ marriage I remember is the union recorded in the album, which closed in 1963 and is still recorded as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ marriage, my mother said in 1965, is the only union that improves by being recorded; every marriage, she said, is a home that has agreed to look like a union. She said the home was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 婚姻；婚礼（指礼堂里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 婚姻；婚礼（指那段婚姻本身，与戒指相对）
C. 固定搭配：begin the marriage 开始这段婚姻
D. n. 婚姻；婚礼（指留给孩子们听的那一句那一段）
E. n. 成家之事（抽象总称，指一处礼堂的婚姻之事）
F. n. 婚姻；婚礼（指相册里写到、被记载的的那一段）
G. n. 家、相守（指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 相守（抽象总称，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: began the marriage that no guest in the hall would have recorded
The marriage, meaning the union itself and not the ring
the marriage at the far aisle
the marriage was the whole of the matter
the marriage had become a line in an album
The marriage of the whole thing
A marriage, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: begin the marriage 意为“开始这段婚姻”，1956 年那位长辈把礼堂里没有一位宾客肯记载的一段婚姻做了一遍。
marriage 意为“婚姻；婚礼”，指那段婚姻本身而不是戒指，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
marriage 意为“婚姻；婚礼”，指礼堂里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一枚小小的戒指。
marriage 意为“婚姻；婚礼”，指最远那条通道留给孩子们听的那一句那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
marriage 意为“家、相守”，指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个家就是那件事的全部。
marriage 意为“相守”，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段婚姻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
marriage 意为“婚姻；婚礼”，指相册里写到、被记载的的那一段，到 1961 年这一段成了相册里的一行。
marriage 意为“成家之事”，长辈五月写道，整件事的婚姻之事是一处礼堂和三个年头的记载。
marriage 意为“婚姻；婚礼”，我记得的是相册里记载过的那一段，1963 年走完了，至今仍被说成礼堂里最安静的一段。
marriage 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，婚姻是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的婚姻。
